transport: Owner gRPC mTLS; Moose official TCP
interface: POSIX/FUSE O_RDONLY buffered defaults; no O_DIRECT/drop_caches/cache-mode repair
order: warmup Owner,Moose; measured Owner,Moose / Moose,Owner alternating

cache.preload: full client SHA followed by full physical payload SHA before EVERY sample, both targets
cache.physical_observer: unchanged physical_cache.py mincore on B before/after every sample; require 67108864 resident payload bytes and stable dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime
cache.client_observer: same passive mincore recorded separately on A before/after; NOT a residency-equality condition
cache.Moose_payload: offset 8192 only if THIS sole physical chunk full payload SHA equals expected; no universal chunk-layout claim

prepare_barrier: fdatasync + parent directory fsync outside read measurement, both targets
replicas: Owner one serving Home B; Moose one connected B chunkserver, one VALID copy, CREATE/KEEP *; read comparison only, not strong write-durable qualification

latency.gate: pooled nearest-rank p95 across 320 measured operations/target <= 0.8 Moose
latency.throughput_gate: median five task rates (open/thread/read/join/close included) >=1.2 Moose

prior_DIRECT_failure: retained; distinct case, no retrospective requalification
